capability: Initiate and progress the three workflows
definition: Forms and task decisions implement the three prescribed processes; retain acceptance provenance separately.
User-facing queue/registry identifies work or current state; filtering is not proof of authorization.
Additional requirement, outside the original common task. An actual diagram renderer or display is connected to the application; a copied BPMN file alone is insufficient.
User can inspect earlier actions; a stored history field or current-status list alone is partial evidence.
User-selectable search/filter controls, beyond automatic filtering for the active role.
Upload/download and associate files with a task or request; bundled task specifications do not count.
Application delivers event notifications; toast acknowledgments and a manual inform-person task do not count.
Implementation writes application state to a database or persistent file; durability under failure is not inferred.

capability: Install or deploy from supplied assets
definition: Instructions or automation identify startup/deployment; reproducibility is untested in this review.
Retained executable application/scenario or reused-runtime regression-test assets; record the supplier. Source presence does not mean passed tests.

capability: Back up and restore application data
definition: Explicit backup/restore tooling or procedure; use of a database alone is insufficient.
Identity is established through an enforcing service rather than selecting a persona or trusting browser state.
Trusted service checks caller permissions for data and operations. ASVS 5.0.0 V8.2.1, V8.2.2, V8.3.1.
Server checks session/token on protected operations; token generation or local UI login alone is insufficient.
Check business values/structure at a trusted boundary. ASVS 5.0.0 V2.2.1 and V2.2.2; selected source paths only, not full compliance.
